name: What are some strategies to reduce ADU construction costs without compromising quality?

mainEntity.name: What are some strategies to reduce ADU construction costs without compromising quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: To reduce ADU costs, consider optimizing the design for efficiency, such as a simpler footprint or using standard material sizes to minimize waste. Opting for a garage conversion can significantly lower costs compared to new construction due to existing foundations and utility access. Additionally, careful material selection, such as mid-range finishes instead of high-end custom options, can provide savings. Prioritizing essential features and understanding where you can make tradeoffs between custom elements and standard solutions is key to staying within budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Reduce ADU costs by optimizing design, considering garage conversions, selecting efficient materials, and making strategic tradeoffs between custom and standard features.
